description:
Stay updated on your family’s live location and travel history—whether you want to keep an eye on your kids or look after aging parents, it couldn't be easier.

Share your whereabouts in real time, receive instant notifications, and stay connected no matter where you are.

A straightforward way to safeguard your loved ones.

Main Features:

★ Track Their Location:​ See where your family members are right now and monitor their movements directly from your device.

★ Send Your Location:​ Instantly share your current position with your family so they always know where you are.

★ Zone Alerts:​ Designate important areas like home, school, or office. Get notified as soon as a parent or child arrives or leaves these zones.

★ Route History:​ Browse past locations and routes of your loved ones, and search by specific dates.

★ Find Nearby Places:​ Discover close-by restaurants, hotels, banks, and more—great for planning daily errands and outings.

Ideal For:

👧 Parents concerned about their children’s safety outdoors

👴 People caring for elderly relatives

🏖️ Business supervisors

Get in Touch

Having trouble or questions while using the GPS tracking features? Our support team is ready to assist you.

Reach us at: nd5star.contact@gmail.com

Legal Notice:

Privacy Policy:​ Every function in this app runs only after receiving your clear permission. All location tracking starts only with your explicit approval.

Data Protection:​ Your location information is encrypted and secured. We never sell or share your personal location data with outside parties. You remain in full control of sharing preferences.

Proper Use:​ Unauthorized tracking is not allowed. You must ensure that everyone whose location is shared has given their informed consent.
summary: Real-time Family Locator and Location Sharing App
title: Phone GPS Tracker
